groups.activity: rank up with the Entrati to Associate (Rank 3)
conditions: Rank 2 alone unlocks Sepulcrum's purchase, but the Receiver can't be built until Rank 3 opens Otak's Xenorhast blueprint, so plan for Rank 3 from the start.
Entrati members hand out Family Tokens, not standing directly; trade tokens to Grandmother for standing.
bonuses: Tier 5 Mother bounties are the standing engine; two or three runs commonly fill a day's cap.
Mother Tokens don't expire; over-farm on free days and cash in on later resets.

rows.label: Sepulcrum Blueprint
rows.alt: claim as the free Rank 2 rank-up reward

rows.label: Purified Heciphron Blueprint
rows.note: 2,000 standing, Rank 1 Neutral; makes 10 per build

rows.label: Trapezium Xenorhast Blueprint
rows.note: 8,000 standing, Rank 3 Associate; makes 3 per build
rows.alt: tradeable; buy the refined gem directly to skip Rank 3

conditions: The Sepulcrum wiki page still lists Isolation Vault bounties as a Xenorhast source, but Hotfix 29.5.9 removed rare Deimos gems from those tables; mine it instead.

groups.activity: trade family tokens up to Grandmother Tokens
groups.meta: 10 Grandmother Tokens buys the single Seriglass Shard
conditions: Grandmother's 'Mend the Family' trades cycle every 8 hours and hand out family tokens for spare Deimos resources, gems and fish parts.
Budget one Seriglass Shard here; the Entrati Rank 5 sacrifice eats a separate one.
bonuses: Stockpile Grandmother Tokens instead of cashing every family token for standing.

groups.activity: mine blue Heciphron and teal Xenorhast veins; refine at Otak
groups.meta: Advanced Nosam Cutter or Sunpoint Plasma Drill

rows.label: Trapezium Xenorhast
rows.note: Receiver; refine raw Xenorhast, one build makes 3

conditions: Get the Sunpoint Plasma Drill (Solaris United, 2,500 standing, no rank) before hunting Xenorhast; it has better special-gem odds and skips the Ostron Rank 4 Advanced Nosam Cutter gate.
Cambion Drift gem rarity increases farther from the Necralisk gate; the cave systems either side of the Catabolic Gutter are dense with veins.

rows.label: Pustulent Cognitive Nodule
rows.note: Barrel; Aquapulmo (Vome, surface) or Cryptosuctus (Fass, surface)

rows.label: Dendrite Blastoma
rows.note: Receiver; Vitreospina or Barbisteo, caves, either cycle

groups.activity: mine and refine Travoride and Coprun

rows.label: Travocyte Alloy
rows.note: Barrel; Smokefinger blueprint, Solaris United Neutral

rows.label: Coprite Alloy
rows.note: Receiver; Old Man Suumbaat blueprint, Ostron Rank 1 Offworlder

conditions: These are the only Fortuna/Ostron detours in the build; buy both refining blueprints early, neither needs deep standing.

rows.label: Barrel
rows.note: 20,000 cr, 30 Travocyte Alloy, 5 Purified Heciphron, 20 Pustulent Cognitive Nodule, 5 Morphics

rows.label: Receiver
rows.note: 20,000 cr, 40 Coprite Alloy, 5 Purified Heciphron, 20 Dendrite Blastoma, 2 Trapezium Xenorhast

conditions: Explosions self-stagger at close range; plan a stagger-immunity solution before using it point-blank.
